# Pinned YUNG sources

These directories are unmodified Git snapshots from the 26.1.2 branches. Each SOURCE.json records the repository, exact commit, and SHA-256 of every imported file. See the original LICENSE in each upstream directory.

The maintained Paper adaptation is in integrations/lbr-structures. tools/prepare-yungs-port.py and tools/adapt-yungs-26-3.py assist source refreshes; they do not replace the reviewed semantic adapters and are not run during normal builds.
